title: Gazette of India Extraordinary, Seed Notification S.O. 1498(E)
authors: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
version: Notification dated 1 April 2019 in Gazette No. 1326 of 2 April 2019, Part II, section 3(ii), pp. 9–10, official Gazette copy hosted by AIREA

passages.locator: pp. 9–10, S.O. 1498(E), English table serial 6 spanning page break
passages.note: Notifies CR Dhan 801 (IET 25667) under the Seeds Act. The indicated states for sale are Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal. The notification was dated 1 April, effective on publication on 2 April. It records no actual sales.

passages.locator: p. 1, Gazette masthead and pp. 9–10, English text preceding the table
passages.note: The Gazette issue is dated 2 April 2019. The notification is effective on publication.
